stage_recorded: After the first development condition; before expanded development completed

holdout_gate.rationale: A small exploratory gate, not a statistical significance test. Expensive full rollouts require a material development benefit before further performance testing.

if_gate_passes.selection: eligible candidate with lowest expanded mean total seconds

diagnostic_rules: Compare action cost differences against a common baseline; do not equate exact scenario execution with accurate prediction of the real hidden world.
Historical true sources may only drive post-hoc counterfactual APIs and never the online policy.
Report source-layout count separately from repeated error-field conditions.
Report cached wall-clock times as cached, not independent runtime claims.
Keep all negative and incomplete results; incomplete scenario rollouts cannot receive artificially low costs.
